maxRetries.description: Maximum number of times the operation will be retried (not including the initial try).

initialSleepMillis.description: Sleep time for first retry (plus randomization). If <= 0 the default will be used.

exponent.description:
The exponent to multiply the prior wait time in generating the next. This should be > 1.0 and probably less than
3.0. Note that 2.0 will double the maximum possible wait each time. If <= 1 the default will be used.

maxSleepMillis.description: Maximum wait time allowed for each retry. If <= 0 the default will be used.

maxTotalMillis.description: Maximum wait time allowed for all retry waits

doNotFailOnTimeout.description: Do not fail if waits times out
